calls.collab_topic_vols: collab_data._load_collab_topic_vols(ctx, a, b)  # topic_id -> vol slice
calls.overview: compare_data.overview(ctx, ids) -> 9 KPI cols per institution_id, read straight off index.parquet
calls.per_sdg: compare_data.metric_frame(ctx, subs, ids, 'sdg', metric) for metric in ['share','si','pp','fwci']; same pin rules as subfield.
calls.per_subfield: for each of the 26 field_ids: compare_data.metric_frame(ctx, subs, ids, 'subfield', metric, field_id=field_id) for metric in ['share','si','pp','fwci']; pp/fwci ignore subs (basis/tree-pinned); share/si use subs=bestfit/full. Rows keyed by (institution_id, taxon_id).

note: Compare is PINNED to bestfit/full (the two-slot Compare's basis+tree pin). fwci and pp are BASIS- and TREE-pinned inside compare_data.py itself (they never read subs) so their values are identical regardless of the scenario passed; share/si are bestfit/full here to match the pin.
